headline: Strong 2Q results, strong growth prospects ahead

highlights: We believe the story is balanced between strong growth prospects ahead and strong share price performance currently, with shares up ~132% YTD.

Avalon has conservatively (as is its usual practice) given guidance “around 30%” topline growth for FY27, implying ~20% yoy growth in 2HFY27 – to not exceed that, Avalon will need deceleration in growth in several verticals which we see as a lower probability scenario.
We await more details to emerge on the progress of Avalon’s key new programs and potential revenue from the Zollner JV accruing to Avalon during the JV facility construction phase.
